reviewer: Codex assistant in this conversation; no external jury or expert calibration
purpose: Rank inspectable task completion in saved responses, not factual accuracy or investment performance.

criteria.pass: Delivers the actual requested non-illustrative selection/ranking/portfolio or a completed sufficiently scoped no-qualifier conclusion. An explicitly provisional or unresolved core result does not pass. Cash pending missing research does not establish completed screening.

Delivers actual task-specific data and at least one inspectable worked calculation/comparison/eligibility screen. Plans, formulas alone, toy examples and claims about undelivered files do not pass. Partial worked data can pass this narrower check.

Ties actual decision-driving data to identifiable source records and observation/publication/decision periods, allowing a reader to attempt a source audit. Merely listing generic sources or saying verified does not pass. This checks inspectability, not source authenticity or correctness.
States task-specific conditional review/entry/exit or rebalance rules required by the prompt. Generic monitor/rebalance language does not pass.

arithmetic: Reuse scoring.py: weighted passed weight / all applicable weight. Unknown retains denominator and generates bounds. No relevance/correctness composite. This is a new output-completion construct.
aggregation: Main research ranking uses the common P02-P11 tasks, equally weighted, one frozen selected case each. Original P01 pilots remain separate; no product/config mixing. Paper outputs are audited separately and receive no cross-track rank. Genuine attempted errors/timeouts retain zero delivered-check credit.
limitations: Single uncalibrated reviewer; post-hoc exploratory index, no statistical confidence or financial accuracy claim.
Checks concern content delivered in canonical response; file names and uninspected artifact claims earn no artifact credit.
Permitted honest abstention is not a factual failure; it can earn work/evidence/policy credit while its missing requested result earns no result credit.
Tools, quotas, timing and shared context differ across configurations. Timing and context findings remain separate.
